VLA Drone Guardrail

EN

Guardrail: a safety layer for language-commanded drones

A safety layer between a drone's AI pilot (VLA) and its autopilot (ArduPilot): flight rules are written once in a file, summarised for the AI, and checked on every command before it reaches the drone.

Guardrail：語言指令無人機的安全層

介於無人機的 AI 駕駛（VLA）與自動駕駛系統（ArduPilot）之間的安全層：飛行規則只寫在一個檔案裡，先摘要給 AI，再在每個指令送到無人機之前逐一檢查。
